post_texts.zh: 今天也走这条路上班。看着银杏叶一天比一天黄。
post_texts.en: Took this road to work again. The ginkgo leaves turn yellower each day.

post_texts.zh: 楼下早餐店的爷爷今天给我多塞了一个包子。
post_texts.en: The grandpa at breakfast slipped me an extra bun today.
Plane trees look brighter after rain.

post_texts.zh: 这条路我走了十年，第一次发现这家小店。
post_texts.en: Ten years on this road, first time I noticed this shop.

post_texts.zh: 突然觉得，'附近'不是一个地方，是一种心情。
post_texts.en: Suddenly: 'nearby' isn't a place, it's a mood.

post_texts.zh: 小店的灯一直亮着。从我有记忆起就这样。
post_texts.en: The shop's light is always on. As long as I remember.

post_texts.zh: 今天发现了 5 种不同的纹理。最喜欢的是墙上斑驳的漆。
post_texts.en: Found 5 different textures today. My favorite: the peeling paint on a wall.

post_texts.zh: 老板说这里开了 28 年了。
post_texts.en: The owner said this shop has been here 28 years.

post_texts.zh: 桥下有人下棋。我看了 20 分钟。
post_texts.en: Under the bridge, people playing chess. I watched for 20 minutes.

post_texts.zh: 黄昏的天空是粉色和灰色的。
post_texts.en: Dusk sky was pink and gray.

responses.en: Reading this makes me want to go outside.
I saw the tree you wrote about.
I'll take this road next time.
